cpuThermalCharacterization.interpretation: P-core readings respond strongly to targeted load. E-core target deltas are smaller and other-core deltas can exceed the targeted E-core delta, so E-core readouts must not yet be treated as independent sensors. Hottest-core plus package remains the safety/control aggregate.

broaderBehavioralInterpretation.evidence: Within C06-C09 pairwise mean absolute differences were 0.04-0.19 C with 86-97% exact matches. Within C10-C13 they were 0.03-0.15 C with 92-98% exact matches. Cross-cluster differences were about 2.53-2.61 C with only 23-24% exact matches.

secondRun.policyDecision: Keep all raw core-context readings for diagnostics, but do not assume independent E-core sensors. Safety/control continues to use max(package,hottest reported core-context temperature).

extendedRangeQualificationAttempt1.anomaly: single control-evidence read reported MaxFan=0x90 with FanSwitch=0x00
extendedRangeQualificationAttempt1.interpretation: Unconfirmed transient EC guard read. Harness now requires duplicate stable guard reads and bounded confirmation before treating a nonzero guard as persistent.

extendedRangeQualificationAttempt2.anomaly: baseline narrow EC evidence reported CPU setpoint 144 and GPU setpoint 255
extendedRangeQualificationAttempt2.interpretation: No level was written. The mixed setpoint is not a valid state for this equal-only harness. Ownership reads are now duplicated under one EC mutex lease, and asymmetric samples are re-read at the high-level qualification boundary before being treated as persistent.

extendedRangeQualificationAttempt3.confirmedUserObservation: system entered hibernation during the run
extendedRangeQualificationAttempt3.interpretation: SetThreadExecutionState/ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED did not prevent this hibernation transition. Broad sweep must treat any hibernate-like telemetry gap as a terminal run condition and diagnose the Windows/firmware transition source before continuing.

evidence: Kernel-Power event 524: critical battery trigger met
The same event sequence occurred twice
SleepStudy showed battery capacity collapsing from full to 0 and then returning to full, including while AC was reported online
powerTransitionDiagnosis.interpretation: This was not an idle-sleep timeout and is not evidence that fan level 21 or 28 itself requests hibernation. The strongest current hypothesis is transient/corrupted ACPI battery telemetry during intensive direct EC access. Extended qualification is being throttled and guarded by Windows AC/battery status.

extendedRangeQualificationAttempt4.status: refused before EC baseline/write by SafetyGate plausibility
extendedRangeQualificationAttempt4.interpretation: NVML returned success with an unusable 0 C GPU temperature while the dGPU was at very low power. This is now treated as unavailable telemetry rather than a valid complete snapshot; the active harness waits boundedly for SafetyGate-ready telemetry before any fan write.

level21Retest.note: Previously inconclusive due to false critical-battery hibernation; passed cleanly after EC traffic reduction and AC/battery guard hardening.

extendedRangeQualificationFinal.interpretation: The HP 8C40 equal-level command primitive is physically characterized across 10..50 under the bounded light-load harness. This does not yet expand the production backend: low-end restart-from-stopped-fan behavior and production endpoint/transition integration remain pending.
